_comment: GENERATED — captured from Figma by scripts/figma-readback.js via the Figma MCP. Do not hand-edit. Refresh after any Figma change, then run: node scripts/check-figma.mjs --stamp

Backgrounds.description: Contract: contracts/background.json — the source of truth for this surface. A section CLASS treatment, not an instanceable component. Do not instance these variants; apply the class bg--{color}[--pattern--{type}] to a section wrapper. The pattern layer is an IMAGE fill, and a Figma variable is COLOR/FLOAT/STRING/BOOLEAN — so no pattern can ever be bound and no checker can ever verify one. These two rules are enforced by instruction only: 1. Never reproduce a pattern with your own background-image. Use the shipped asset named in each variant's caption. 2. Never set opacity on a pattern. Every tile here sits at paint opacity 1.00 because strength is baked into the asset file; there is no CSS opacity anywhere in the shipped system. The colour axis IS bound: solid fill, both text colours and the border colour resolve to semantic tokens. Pattern strength is baked per asset two different ways — brain declares one opacity in the SVG, community and particle fade per pixel (any single number for those is a PEAK, not a level).

Logo.description: Contract: contracts/logo.json in uiowa/uids | Code: src/components/logo/Logo.vue (UidsLogo). Axes: Lockup=healthcare prop (Iowa/HealthCare); Breakpoint=CSS media queries (980/1350); Size=parent brand-bar narrow styling (no code prop; Header context only); Context=context prop — Header (black tab, dims bound to logo/tab/*) or Footer (transparent, width bound to logo/footer/width, right padding 40). Fills bound to logo/fill, logo/text-fill.

Brand Bar.description: Contract: contracts/brand-bar.json in uiowa/uids | Code: src/components/brand-bar/BrandBar.vue (uids-iowa-bar). Axes: Breakpoint (breakpoint)=Mobile/MD/Page; Style (narrow)=Default/Narrow/Parent Title; Healthcare (healthcare)=False/True. Boolean props: Show Parent Title, Show Second Row, Show Site Name. The contract is authoritative on options, tokens and behaviour — this is a pointer to it, not a copy. Required page header. Site name shows in the bar (Show Site Name + Site Name). For the WithParentSiteTitle pattern use Style=Parent Title: parent title (Parent Title text prop) sits beside the logo in a narrow bar and the site h1 (Site Name text prop) moves to the white second row — mirrors BrandBar.stories.js, where a second row forces narrow. The booleans (Show Parent Title / Show Second Row) remain available for custom compositions on Default/Narrow. Narrow logo tab hangs 6px below the bar at Breakpoint=Page and paints above the second row.

Brand Footer.description: Contract: contracts/brand-footer.json in uiowa/uids | Code: src/components/brand-footer/BrandFooter.vue (uids-iowa-footer / UidsIowaFooter). Axes: Breakpoint=media queries 980/1350; Healthcare=healthcare prop. Props mirror slots: Site Name/Parent Title/Contact (NOTE: in code the parent_site_title slot only renders when the same-named PROP is truthy). Socket links are hardcoded in code (Privacy/Nondiscrimination/Accessibility); copyright year is dynamic. Contact text weight is bound to font/weight/thin (declared 100 in CSS — renders 300 on web since Roboto 100 is not loaded; see contract knownIssues).

Button.description: Contract: contracts/button.json in uiowa/uids | Code: src/components/button/Button.vue (UidsButton). Axes: Color=color prop (Primary/Secondary/Tertiary); Size=size prop (Small/Medium/Large); Style=transparent + light_font props collapsed into ONE axis (Default/Transparent/Light Font), following the Brand Bar precedent. In code those two are independent booleans and can combine — use the code props for that. borderless and full are deliberately NOT axes (single-property overrides; see the contract). Style=Transparent overrides Color, and Style=Light Font overrides Size, because those rules come later in button.scss — so some combinations render identically; each variant still shows what that prop combination actually produces. The hover/focus underline (button/focus-bar/*) is an interaction state and is not modelled as a variant.

Form Item.description: Generated from contracts/form.json (UIDS). Axes: Control (8 visual archetypes, not the ~14 HTML types the :not() list matches) x State (Focus shows the input:focus treatment; keyboard :focus-visible on check controls is black, documented in the contract) x Size (form--large retheme) x Checked (sparse: check controls only). Disabled+checked toggle renders GRAY, not gold (--form-input-bg-disabled !important). Native control glyphs (checkbox/radio/toggle knob word-trick, select arrow, file button) are UA-rendered in the browser; these are idealized drawings — see contract geometryNotTokenized. compact/flex/inline/light are contract-only (auto-layout/spacing decisions).

Form Fieldset.description: Generated from contracts/form-fieldset.json (UIDS). Legend axis: Top (border-below legend, stacked items) vs Side (border-right legend floated beside the item row — the .form-fieldset--side-legend container-query pattern; below 768px container width it renders as Top). Content = nested Form Item instances. The gap/padding bind form/item-margin, owned by the form contract (expected cross-component read, see contract notes).

Headline.description: UIDS Headline (.headline). Axes: Level (H1-H6) x Style (Default/Serif/Uppercase/Underline/Highlight) x Alignment (Default/Center) — underline+highlight+text_style collapse onto Style (Button precedent); combos beyond the five values are code-only (use the code props). Highlight requires an inner &lt;span&gt; in code (slot protocol — see contracts/headline.json behavior). On-gold context flips (highlight inversion, declared-400 uppercase weight, gray underline bar) are context frames, not axes. Uppercase renders Antonio; declared bold = static 700 face. Alignment=Center mirrors .headline--center: the text centres AND the underline bar centres independently (counter-axis CENTER here, margin-inline auto in CSS) — a parent text-align alone leaves the bar hard left, which is why this is an option and not inherited context. Alignment=Default is the inherit/no-class case, not a forced left.

Banner.description: Contract: contracts/banner.json in uiowa/uids | Code: src/components/banner/Banner.vue (uids-banner). Axes: Fill (background)=Media/Background; Direction (media_overlay_type)=None/BTT/TTB/LTR; Tone (media_overlay_light)=Dark/Light; Height (height)=Large/Medium. The contract is authoritative on options, tokens and behaviour — this is a pointer to it, not a copy. Full-bleed hero. Fill chooses the mechanism (a media element with a scrim, or a background colour); Direction and Tone describe the scrim and only exist on Fill=Media, because CSS makes them inert on a background-filled banner.

Card.description: UIDS Card. Axes: Orientation (the only validated prop) x Style (bordered/borderless) x Button. DRAWN WIDTHS DIFFER BY ORIENTATION AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: Stacked is 480, a twocol column at the 1020 narrow container; Left/Right are 720, because card's layout switches on a CONTAINER query at 400px (card.scss:5-16, keyed on $break-xxsm against @container column) and at 480 the default media--large 52.5% basis leaves the body too narrow for the button — real as-shipped behaviour, since .bttn is inline-block and will not shrink. Card's button is NOT a designer surface: the four classes are hardcoded at Card.vue:124 and independently at SiteNow's uiowa_core.module:539-544, so the Button axis selects between the two paints CONTENT produces (label present vs absent), nesting the Button set's sparse Transparent Light Font and Circle variants. The third reachable paint - a real anchor with no arrow, rendered when a card has no title - is deliberately not drawn; see contracts/card.json knownIssues.arrowless-anchor. Media is a neutral grey placeholder, not a tokenized fill. Pre-title, subtitle, meta and the date circle carry tokens no variant shows and belong on a documentation frame.
